name: Ciabatta
siboNotes: Contains wheat-based fructans that can trigger SIBO symptoms. Start with smallest serving size and monitor tolerance carefully.
preparationTips: Toast lightly to improve digestibility for some people
Pair with low-FODMAP proteins and fats to slow digestion
Consider sourdough ciabatta made with long fermentation
Store properly to maintain texture without additives
alternatives: Sourdough bread (spelt or wheat with long fermentation)
Gluten-free bread made with rice flour
